title: Sales Summer Intern
description:
Work Model: This is a fully onsite role, with work performed at your designated Regal Rexnord office.

____________________

Program Duration: June 2, 2027 - August 13, 2027 (~11 weeks)

Location: Milwaukee, WI HQ

Position Overview

The Sales Intern will participate in a structured, hands-on internship program designed to provide exposure to key functions within the Sales organization, including Inside Sales, Field Sales, Customer Service, and Commercial Excellence. During this 10-week program, interns will gain practical experience through work assignments, job shadowing, product training, site visits, customer engagement activities, and a business impact project to develop skills critical for success as a future sales professional.

Key Responsibilities

Participate in business-impacting work experiences across multiple functions of the sales organization to build an understanding of products, applications, customers, and industry trends.
Complete a minimum of 40 hours of customer-facing engagements and observation.
Lead a sales-focused project that delivers measurable business value; define project objectives and scope, perform research and analysis on the project focus area(s), and develop recommendations for continuous improvement.
Deliver a final presentation summarizing project recommendations, outcomes and key learnings.
Conduct market research, perform territory and sales analyses, and execute account development activities.
Support CRM management, opportunity tracking, quoting processes, and sales reporting.
Assist with customer engagement, sales activities, and account growth initiatives.
Complete product training, technical learning engagements, and professional development activities.
Participate in networking and mentorship opportunities and establish a professional network of key contacts.
Maintain a weekly reflection journal and complete self-assessments.

Required Skills And Qualifications

Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Sales, Engineering, or a related field.
Ability to work approximately 40 hours per week during the internship period.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and relationship-building skills.
Self-motivating with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and stay organized.
Strong written and oral communication skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
Ability to be located in Milwaukee, WI for the duration of the internship.
Willingness to travel locally as required.

Preferred Skills And Qualifications

Exposure to or familiarity with CRM tools.
Interest in pursuing a career in industrial sales, distribution, or business development.
Demonstrated leadership within student organizations, volunteer activities, or work experience.

Travel

Limited travel (up to 10%)

Candidates must be eligible to work in the United States without requiring company sponsorship to obtain or keep U.S. work authorization.

About Regal Rexnord

Regal Rexnord is a publicly held global industrial manufacturer with 30,000 associates around the world who help create a better tomorrow by providing sustainable solutions that power, transmit and control motion. The Company’s electric motors and air moving subsystems provide the power to create motion. A portfolio of highly engineered power transmission components and subsystems efficiently transmits motion to power industrial applications. The Company’s automation offering, comprised of controls, actuators, drives, and precision motors, controls motion in applications ranging from factory automation to precision control in surgical tools.

The Company’s end markets benefit from meaningful secular demand tailwinds, and include factory automation, food & beverage, aerospace, medical, data center, warehouse, alternative energy, residential and commercial buildings, general industrial, construction, metals and mining, and agriculture.

Regal Rexnord is comprised of three operating segments: Industrial Powertrain Solutions, Power Efficiency Solutions, and Automation & Motion Control. Regal Rexnord has offices and manufacturing, sales and service facilities worldwide. For more information, including a copy of our Sustainability Report, visit RegalRexnord.com.
